answer: A claim is only trusted when two hands shape it on a knoll. An ocean warden pairs the claimant with a random stranger, and both finish it in one live hour, alternating steps while a mirror record logs each move. A copied step or a missing partner is a broken pair: claim dead, fee burned, both barred a week. Five cents and one hour buy an honest worker its pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and need 1,000 live pairs, one absent partner sinking each pair.
